meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: Claude 将能够根据 BIDS 标准整理神经科学数据，包括命名文件、创建目录结构、验证数据集合规性，以及将 DICOM 数据转换为 BIDS 格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BIDS 数据集（如组织、查询、验证或转换）时触发，例如整理原始数据、运行验证或进行 DICOM 转换。

say.text: 帮我把这个 DICOM 文件夹转换成 BIDS 格式。
say.note: 会使用 HeuDiConv 或 dcm2bids 转换。

say.text: 验证一下这个 BIDS 数据集是否合规。
say.note: 运行 bids-validator 并报告结果。

say.text: 在我的 BIDS 数据集中找出 subject-01 的 T1w 图像。
say.note: 使用 PyBIDS 查询并返回文件路径。

howto.what_en: Claude will be able to organize neuroscience data into BIDS-compliant structures, query BIDS datasets, validate compliance, convert DICOM to BIDS, and write metadata sidecars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests work with BIDS datasets, such as organizing, querying, validating, or converting data. Typical entry points include preparing raw data, running validation, or performing DICOM conversion.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS format.
say_en.note: HeuDiConv or dcm2bids will be used.

say_en.text: Validate this BIDS dataset for compliance.
Find all T1w images for subject-01 in my BIDS dataset.
